title: Hormone priming and metabolic engineering of phytohormone crosstalk in rice under combined biotic and abiotic stresses: a multi-omics perspective for climate-resilient crop development.
authors: Shuixing, Zhu; Jing, Zhu; Alshehri, Dikhnah; Al-Amrah, Hadba; Manzoor, Irfan; Aiying, Yu
one_liner_zh: 该综述从多组学视角探讨水稻激素引发与代谢工程应对复合胁迫，虽提及转录因子WRKY/MYB/NAC和AI数字孪生，但核心是作物胁迫响应与工程策略，缺乏蛋白质-DNA互作建模或TF-DNA结合机制研究，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: Rice (Oryza sativa L.) is the caloric backbone for more than half of humanity, yet it remains one of the most vulnerable crops to the simultaneous biotic and abiotic stresses exacerbated by climate change. Phytohormone priming and the complex crosstalk networks governed by transcription factor hubs like WRKY, MYB, and NAC serve as the central adaptive mechanism for stress resilience. This review synthesizes how multi-omics integration, including spatial and single-cell transcriptomics, is resolving the molecular architecture of hormonal priming and epigenetic stress memory. We critically evaluate advanced metabolic engineering and genome-editing strategies such as CRISPR-Cas9, base/prime editing, and synthetic gene circuits that enable precision modifications to decouple stress tolerance from historical yield penalties. Furthermore, we discuss the emerging roles of microbiome-assisted priming via synthetic consortia and the application of artificial intelligence and digital twins (continuously updated computational models of crop physiology) for predictive stress management. By integrating these diverse technological pillars, we propose a systems-level roadmap for developing climate-resilient rice cultivars capable of maintaining yield stability across a volatile combinatorial stress landscape. This synthesis provides a framework for translating mechanistic hormonal insights into field-applicable cultivars to ensure global food security.
abstract_zh: 水稻（Oryza sativa L.）是超过一半人类热量的主要来源，然而它仍然是最易受气候变化加剧的生物和非生物胁迫同时影响的作物之一。植物激素引发（phytohormone priming）以及由WRKY、MYB和NAC等转录因子枢纽调控的复杂交叉对话网络，是胁迫韧性的核心适应机制。本综述综合了多组学整合（包括空间和单细胞转录组学）如何解析激素引发和表观遗传胁迫记忆的分子架构。我们批判性评估了先进的代谢工程和基因组编辑策略，如CRISPR-Cas9、碱基/引物编辑（base/prime editing）和合成基因回路，这些技术能够实现精准修饰，以将胁迫耐受性与历史产量损失脱钩。此外，我们讨论了通过合成菌群进行的微生物组辅助引发的新兴作用，以及人工智能和数字孪生（作物生理的持续更新计算模型）在预测性胁迫管理中的应用。通过整合这些多样化的技术支柱，我们提出了一个系统层面的路线图，用于开发能够在波动的组合胁迫环境中维持产量稳定性的气候韧性水稻品种。本综述为将机制性激素见解转化为田间适用品种提供了框架，以确保全球粮食安全。
